queryParameters.q: Search personal chats and projects in the sidebar.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: Ask Jait to work in a personal or project conversation, use tools, and inspect the results.
examples: Run a command in this project

features.description: Render Mermaid diagrams directly in chat with preserved source and visible parse errors.
Render an explicit link to where a Jait change happened.
Continue a chat towards an explicit goal across turns, with progress, verification evidence, pause/resume and quiet completion notifications.
Search persisted conversations and inspect exact chat traces.
Read, edit, search, execute, and preview work in the active project.

queryParameters.q: Filter conversations by name or network.
queryParameters.messageQ: Search loaded decrypted message text; bounded to 50 joined rooms, not complete history.
queryParameters.service: Filter conversations by exact service label, e.g. WhatsApp.
queryParameters.homeserver: Prefill existing Matrix homeserver sign-in; no credentials.

messenger.title: Messenger
messenger.description: Read and reply to personal conversations through a Matrix homeserver and installed bridges. This inbox is independent of AI chat and assistant channels.

features.description: Gateway-owned Matrix connection shared across signed-in Jait devices, with encrypted messages, attachments, invitations, search, and bridge setup conversations. Login, sync, and encryption keys persist on the gateway. Assistant access explicitly shares requested messages with the configured model. Bridge coverage depends on the installed adapter; Teams tenant support is not guaranteed.

queryParameters.panel: Use team-chats to open the team chats panel.
queryParameters.teamQ: Filter team chats by name; use panel=team-chats.
queryParameters.agentQ: Search agents in the new team chat dialog; use panel=team-chats.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Manage persistent Jait people and teams: profiles, personas, roles, reporting lines, providers, models, repositories, skills, and tool preferences. These are saved agents from the Agents page, distinct from temporary execution workers.

features.description: List, inspect, create, update, pause, and delete persistent agent profiles and configure reporting relationships.
Named team chats with selected agent membership, a room list and avatar grid on the Agents page, existing hierarchy rooms, addressed handoffs, user participation, and neutral source-chat relays.
Run work using a saved personaAgentId; use cron tools for executable schedules. Profile schedules and tasks describe preferences; saving a profile alone does not launch work.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: Create, start, resume, interrupt, and review execution threads, including work assigned to saved agents.
examples: Create a pull request from a thread

features.description: Control execution and review activities using thread IDs or saved personaAgentId values.

pulls.title: Pull Requests
pulls.description: Inspect repository pull requests and prepare changes for review.
examples: Create a PR from this thread

features.description: Prepare a pull request from completed thread work.

queryParameters.q: Search todos by text, tag, status, or date.

todo.title: Todo
todo.description: Manage saved follow-up tasks across chats and track multi-step work.

features.description: List, add, update, and remove durable todos.

queryParameters.q: Provider mail search query (Gmail syntax or Outlook search); applied automatically on navigation.
queryParameters.folder: Mailbox folder or label; defaults to inbox.

email.title: Email
email.description: Read and organize mail using connected accounts and available channel tools.

features.description: Connect multiple Gmail, Outlook or secure IMAP/SMTP accounts, manage account signatures, and render messages in chat. Account setup requires the Email page; sending and deletion retain their tool consent checks.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: View and manage calendar events using connected calendar accounts.

features.uiOnlyReason: Calendar tool availability depends on connected accounts.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Inspect and maintain durable memories, preferences, and reminders. Saved memory is separate from persisted chat history.

features.description: Search, save, list, and remove durable context.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Manage scheduled and recurring work and inspect job execution.

features.description: Create, update, list, and remove executable scheduled jobs.

network.title: Network
network.description: Discover connected nodes and authorized network assets, manage assessment scopes, inspect evidence and findings, and verify improvements.

features.description: Discover assets and inspect network state.
Use registered security tools with their scope and consent requirements.

queryParameters.q: Search settings across tabs; overrides saved search, including q= to clear.
queryParameters.tab: Settings tab: general, api, tools, extensions, skills, email, channels, nodes, shortcuts, usage, activity, changelog.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure Jait, providers, models, tool policies, skills, plugins, channels, and gateway services.

features.description: Inspect available tools and the live product capability catalog.

metadata.name: jait.catalog
metadata.description: Discover what the Jait harness and its pages can do. Returns a live feature tree, explanations, exact tool references and schemas, missing tool coverage, and page links. For persistent teams choose agents; execution workers belong to threads.

query.description: Optional user outcome or page search. Omit to get the entire tree.

toolOffset.description: Tool pagination offset for the selected page. Each page returns at most 15 tool references.
